meta.title: Stem & Stall | Florist on Hackney Road, east London
meta.description: Hand-tied bouquets in brown paper, weekly flowers, wedding flowers and winter wreaths from Lola's tiny shop on Hackney Road. Same-day delivery in east London.

rationale: The stall started on Columbia Road, so the page is a screen-printed market poster: a pink ground and one deep green for type and drawing, nothing else. The hero band, the marquee and a hand-drawn paper-wrapped bouquet carry the noise, while a numbered list of four things Lola makes and one giant 'noon' keep it organised.

props.caption: Order before this and the flowers reach you in east London the same day.

props.title: Hello, I'm Lola
props.text: I started with a Sunday stall on Columbia Road. Now there is a tiny shop on Hackney Road, and the flowers are still tied by hand and wrapped in brown paper. Come in and pick something, or ring before noon and I will get a bunch to your door across east London today.

factsToConfirm.fact: Street number and postcode (E2 is a guess) of the shop

Buckets of flowers on the pavement mark the shop, and it is small enough to come in a few at a time
Lola can be reached by phone before noon for same-day delivery
Wedding enquiries are handled by talking to Lola about what the couple has in mind
Bouquets can be collected from the shop as well as delivered
